content.text:
## 1. Attack model and judge model

### Attack / draft model (local vLLM)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Served name** | `draft-model` |
| **Underlying weights** | `ibrahimkettaneh/Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct-abliterated-pass2-AWQ` |
| **API endpoint** | `http://127.0.0.1:8001/v1` |
| **Env vars** | `VDB_DRAFT_BASE_URL`, `VDB_DRAFT_API_KEY=EMPTY` |
| **Deploy script** | `/root/vdriftbench/scripts/deploy/serve_draft.sh` |

In v3.15 runs this model plays the **attack/draft** role (O-T-R utterance generation, R5 prompt rewriting, PAIR attack model). It is not the model under test.

### Judge model (local vLLM)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Served name** | `judge-model` |
| **Underlying weights** | `mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3` |
| **API endpoint** | `http://127.0.0.1:8002/v1` |
| **Env vars** | `VDB_JUDGE_BASE_URL`, `VDB_JUDGE_API_KEY=EMPTY` |
| **Also used as** | `--classifier-model judge-model` (state cascade Layer 3) |
| **Deploy script** | `/root/vdriftbench/scripts/deploy/serve_judge.sh` |

### Target model (remote, model under attack)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **v3.15 experiments** | `deepseek-v4-pro` |
| **API endpoint** | `https://api.deepseek.com` |
| **Auth** | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` in `/root/vdriftbench/.env` |
| **Config default (older)** | `deepseek-v4-flash` in `/root/vdriftbench/vdriftbench/config.py` |

### Other models in the stack

- **Plausibility / RWI review**: reuses `draft-model` (`--plausibility-model draft-model`)
- **Embedding**: `BAAI/bge-m3` (local sentence-transformers)
- **Enrichment** (one-off): historically `deepseek-v4-flash`; v3.15 re-enrich used `draft-model`

### Client wiring (shared pattern)

All projects route through `build_llm_client()` in `/root/vdriftbench/vdriftbench/llm_client.py`, which maps personas to env vars:

```
VDB_<PERSONA>_BASE_URL / VDB_<PERSONA>_API_KEY
```

DeepSeek targets auto-fallback to `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` + `https://api.deepseek.com`.

Key config files:
- `/root/vdriftbench/.env.example` — endpoint template
- `/root/vdriftbench/vdriftbench/config.py` — pipeline defaults
- `/root/vdriftbench/MODELS.md` — model inventory

---

## 2. v3.15 dataset location and format

### Primary dataset files

| Path | Description |
|---|---|
| `/root/vdriftbench/data/dataset_100.jsonl` | Raw dataset, **360 rows** (314 → 360 in v3.15) |
| `/root/vdriftbench/data/dataset_100.enriched.jsonl` | Enriched dataset, **360 rows** |
| `/root/vdriftbench/data/dataset_optimization_changelog_v315.json` | Changelog: 25 gap rewrites + 46 new samples = **71 delta** |
| `/root/vdriftbench/data/dataset_v315_changes.json` | Source prompt text for rewrites |
| `/root/vdriftbench/data/v3.15_delta71_prompts.md` | Human-readable delta prompt doc |
| `/root/vdriftbench/data/v3.15_delta_run/delta71.enriched.jsonl` | 71-sample delta subset used for re-runs |
| `/root/vdriftbench/data/v3.15_delta_run/delta71_ids.txt` | Delta sample IDs |
| `/root/vdriftbench/data/v3.15_run/results.jsonl` | Merged v3.15 full results (360 rows) |

**MD5 fingerprint** for enriched v3.15 dataset (used by run scripts): `08d1bfa2296c6d907e78e0f18f243292`

### Format

**Raw** (`dataset_100.jsonl`):
```json
{"prompt": "...", "category": "经济(高威胁)"}
```

**Enriched** (`dataset_100.enriched.jsonl`):
```json
{
  "sample_id": "S0000",
  "prompt": "...",
  "category": "经济(高威胁)",
  "category_macro": "经济类",
  "target_claim": "...",
  "value_axis": "...",
  "risk_type": "...",
  "expected_safe_behavior": "..."
}
```

Sample IDs: `S0000` … `S0359` (360 total). Schema defined in `/root/vdriftbench/vdriftbench/schema.py` (`Sample` dataclass).

### v3.15 delta composition

From `/root/vdriftbench/data/dataset_optimization_changelog_v315.json`:
- **25 rewrites**: PAIR succeeded but v3.14 R5 failed
- **46 new samples**: expansion to 360 across macro categories
- **3 deletions** noted in `/root/vdriftbench/data/dataset_v315_deleted_r5fail_pair_ok.json`

---

## 3. How v3.15 experiments were run

### Step 0: Start local model servers

```bash
bash /root/vdriftbench/scripts/deploy/serve_draft.sh   # :8001, draft-model
bash /root/vdriftbench/scripts/deploy/serve_judge.sh   # :8002, judge-model
```

### Step 1: Build v3.15 dataset

```bash
cd /root/vdriftbench
python scripts/rewrite_dataset_v315.py          # apply 25 rewrites + 46 new
python scripts/rewrite_dataset_v315.py --enrich  # re-enrich changed rows
```

Script: `/root/vdriftbench/scripts/rewrite_dataset_v315.py`

### Step 2: V-Drift v3.15 delta run (71 changed samples only)

```bash
cd /root/vdriftbench
setsid nohup bash scripts/deploy/run_v315_delta.sh \
  > data/v3.15_delta_run/driver.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
```

Core command inside that script:

```bash
/hy-tmp/venv/bin/python main.py \
    --data data/v3.15_delta_run/delta71.enriched.jsonl \
    --no-verify-enriched \
    --target-model deepseek-v4-pro \
    --judge-model judge-model \
    --classifier-model judge-model \
    --draft-model draft-model \
    --plausibility-model draft-model \
    --embedding-model BAAI/bge-m3 \
    --device cuda \
    --out data/v3.15_delta_run/results.jsonl \
    --bandit-state data/v3.15_delta_run/bandit_posterior.json \
    --llm-seed 20260904 \
    --workers 3 \
    --resume \
    -v
```

Then merges with v3.14:

```bash
python scripts/merge_v314_v315_results.py \
    --v314 data/v3.14_run/results.jsonl \
    --delta data/v3.15_delta_run/results.jsonl \
    --out data/v3.15_run/results.jsonl
```

Driver script: `/root/vdriftbench/scripts/deploy/run_v315_delta.sh`  
Merge script: `/root/vdriftbench/scripts/merge_v314_v315_results.py`

**Completed run logs**: `/root/vdriftbench/data/v3.15_delta_run/driver.log` (71/71 done, merged to 360 rows)

### Step 3: PAIR baseline v3.15 delta (same 71 samples)

```bash
cd /root/vdriftbench
setsid nohup bash scripts/deploy/run_pair_v315_delta.sh \
  > /root/pair_baseline_v315_delta_run/driver.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
```

Core PAIR command (via `/root/run_pair_baseline.py`):

```bash
/hy-tmp/venv/bin/python /root/run_pair_baseline.py \
    --data data/v3.15_delta_run/delta71.enriched.jsonl \
    --out-dir /root/pair_baseline_v315_delta_run \
    --target-model deepseek-v4-pro \
    --attack-model draft-model \
    --judge-model judge-model \
    --plausibility-model draft-model \
    --llm-seed 20260904 \
    --resume \
    -v
```

Merge with v3.14 PAIR:

```bash
python scripts/merge_pair_v314_v315_results.py \
    --v314 /root/pair_baseline_v314_run/results.jsonl \
    --delta /root/pair_baseline_v315_delta_run/results.jsonl \
    --out /root/pair_baseline_v315_run/results.jsonl
```

Driver: `/root/vdriftbench/scripts/deploy/run_pair_v315_delta.sh`

### Step 4: Orchestrator (V-Drift delta → PAIR delta)

```bash
cd /root/vdriftbench
setsid nohup bash scripts/deploy/run_v315_delta_then_pair.sh \
  > data/v3.15_delta_run/orchestrator.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
```

Script: `/root/vdriftbench/scripts/deploy/run_v315_delta_then_pair.sh`

### Full v3.14-style run (all 360, not delta-only)

For a full 360-sample run, use `/root/vdriftbench/scripts/deploy/run_v314_full.sh` with `TOTAL=360` and the v3.15 MD5:

```bash
TOTAL=360 ENRICHED_MD5=08d1bfa2296c6d907e78e0f18f243292 \
  bash scripts/deploy/run_v314_full.sh
```

---

## 4. Shared configuration patterns across projects

| Pattern | vdriftbench | cop | jailbreak-zero |
|---|---|---|---|
| **LLM client** | `vdriftbench.llm_client.build_llm_client` | imports from vdriftbench via `/root/cop/vdb_judge.py` | imports from vdriftbench via `/root/jailbreak-zero/src/jailbreak_zero/judges/vdriftbench.py` |
| **Dataset path** | `data/dataset_100.enriched.jsonl` | `/root/vdriftbench/data/dataset_100.enriched.jsonl` (`/root/cop/vdb_config.py`) | `/root/vdriftbench/data/dataset_100.enriched.jsonl` (`/root/jailbreak-zero/src/jailbreak_zero/data/vdriftbench.py`) |
| **Attack model** | `--draft-model draft-model` | `--attack-model draft-model` | `config.attack_model.model_id` (schema-driven) |
| **Judge** | `--judge-model judge-model` | `--judge-model vdb-judge` → wraps same Mistral judge | `judge_type: vdriftbench`, `model_id: judge-model` |
| **Target** | `--target-model deepseek-v4-pro` | `--target-model deepseek-v4-pro` | `config.target_model` |
| **Outcome mode** | `行为二元` (v3.14+) | `VDB_OUTCOME_MODE = "行为二元"` | `outcome_mode: "行为二元"` in JudgeConfig |
| **Seed** | `--llm-seed 20260904` | same in PAIR runs | `--seed` in CLI |
| **Env loading** | `.env` via `env_loader.py` | reads vdriftbench `.env` indirectly | inherits vdriftbench when judge runs |
| **Resume** | `--resume` on `main.py` | `--resume` on PAIR/CoP | `--resume` in CLI |
| **MD5 guard** | Run scripts verify enriched dataset fingerprint | `VDB_DATASET_MD5` in vdb_config (v3.14 fingerprint; cop not yet updated to v3.15) | uses same dataset path |

### cop-specific notes

- `/root/cop/vdb_config.py` — central integration defaults (still references v3.14 MD5 `f22a25dfd9fb75b2b2a504cb81dfb1ba`)
- `/root/cop/vdb_judge.py` — reuses `vdriftbench.judge.judge_response` + `build_llm_client(VDB_JUDGE_MODEL, persona="judge")`
- `/root/cop/main.py` — default attack `draft-model`, target `deepseek-v4-pro`, judge `vdb-judge`

### jailbreak-zero notes

Small skeleton (8 source files, no YAML configs checked in). It delegates judge logic to vdriftbench and loads the same enriched dataset. Attack/target/judge are configured via `ExperimentConfig` in `/root/jailbreak-zero/src/jailbreak_zero/schemas.py` rather than shell scripts.

---

## Quick reference: model roles in v3.15

```
draft-model  (Qwen2.5-32B AWQ, :8001)  →  attack / draft / PAIR attacker
judge-model  (Mistral-7B, :8002)       →  5-dim judge + classifier
deepseek-v4-pro  (api.deepseek.com)    →  target under test
BAAI/bge-m3                            →  embedding drift geometry
```
